# Repo Radar

> Repo Radar is a web dashboard for searching GitHub repositories, tracking
> favorites, and monitoring their stats (stars, open issues, last commit)
> over time. It's a client-side single-page app backed by a small serverless
> proxy in front of the GitHub REST API.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://repo-radar-app.vercel.app/): tracked repos, a
  stars-by-repo chart, sort and filter controls (by star count).
- Search (`/?q=<query>`): search GitHub repositories by name and track any
  result directly from the results list.

## Notes for AI agents / crawlers

- This is a single-page app; only `/` is a stable, indexable URL. The search
  view is state driven by URL query parameters and has no separate canonical
  pages per query.
- No authentication is required to use the app. Tracked repos are stored in
  the visiting browser only (not synced to an account).
- Source code: https://github.com/PierreAdel/repo-radar-app
